summary: No change to the tax or legal regime for a UAE-resident holder of US-listed or Irish UCITS ETFs between 14 and 20 Nov 2026. Four watch items at severity 1: Section 899 revival, UK CCI regime, UAE CARF implementation, Canadian non-resident trust rule. All group scores 0, low confidence.

events.issue: US$60,000 NRA estate threshold for US-situs lines (VOO, IVV, SPY, QQQ, VT, ACWI) unchanged; no FR rule on IRC 2101-2106 in window.
No IRS/Treasury rule on 30% NRA withholding, 871(k)/(m), 1446(f) or W-8BEN in window; only part-1 rule is a 1.36B-2 correction.
Watch: Section 899-style surcharge dormant since OECD side-by-side deal (Jan 2026); Treasury press index shows no in-window action; T2 coverage not checked.
Investor Choice proxy-voting programme for professional intermediaries only (sign-up 16 Nov); fee, index, domicile unchanged.
No in-window notice found; swap fee 0.07% p.a. confirmed on 31 Oct factsheet (pre-window cost data, not a regime change).
No in-window Xtrackers notice found, but notice pages not fully checked.
Ireland-US treaty (15% dividend rate) and Irish fund regime unchanged; eBrief 167/26 is a generic MAP arbitration list update.
Watch: UK FCA CCI regime replaces PRIIPs/KID from 8 Jun 2027; nothing in window; IBKR LSE retail access depends on issuer documents.
No UAE personal income tax measure 14-20 Nov; 18 Nov MoF forum covered EOIR and beneficial ownership only.
Watch: UAE CARF Cabinet Decision targeted for 1 Jan 2027 (Oct circular); obligations on crypto service providers, individuals self-certify; CRS 2.0 adoption unconfirmed.
Canadian citizen: Budget 2026 (pre-window) broadens trust rollout denial to non-resident beneficiaries; no s.128.1/s.94.1 change in NWMM 1; s.116 cut from 2027 favourable.
India FPI tax: SEBI shows no FPI tax circular in window; CBDT not checked (403). Not confirmed either way.
